abilities.effect: The stalactite falls, making an attack against each creature underneath.
abilities.name: Fall
abilities.trigger: A stalactite is damaged or touched

hazard.description: Unstable stalactites fall from the ceiling.
hazard.disable: DC 20 Survival (trained) to remove a stalactite without triggering a fall
hazard.name: Falling Stalactites

traits.name: Environmental
traits.text: A hazard with this trait is something dangerous that’s part of the natural world, such as quicksand or harmful mold.
